ambiguity: “pinpoint the location”: does pinpointing cancel the unseen-target rules (Disadvantage on attacks, 'a creature you can see')?
ruling: No. Pinpointing makes the location known (no guessing the space), but Tremorsense doesn't count as sight. Attacks against the target still have Disadvantage for an unseen target, and spells that need a target you can see stay unavailable.
